# romantic orientation value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:romanticOrientationValue`](gmeow-romanticOrientationValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/romanticOrientationValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sexuality`](../../slices/sexuality.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The [`gmeow:RomanticOrientationValue`](../classes/gmeow-RomanticOrientationValue.md) a romantic-orientation facet asserts (functional per facet). A predefined individual or a fresh one with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label); the single path to the value.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:RomanticOrientation`](../classes/gmeow-RomanticOrientation.md) -> [`gmeow:RomanticOrientationValue`](../classes/gmeow-RomanticOrientationValue.md); functional

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to point a [`gmeow:RomanticOrientation`](../classes/gmeow-RomanticOrientation.md) facet at the one value it asserts — functional per facet, so a single facet names exactly one romantic-orientation value; model a change as a new facet, not a second value here.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it as the sexual-orientation path (that is [`gmeow:sexualOrientationValue`](gmeow-sexualOrientationValue.md)) and avoid forcing the long tail into the seed list; an orientation not seeded is a fresh [`gmeow:RomanticOrientationValue`](../classes/gmeow-RomanticOrientationValue.md) individual with its own [rdfs:label.](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label.)

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:RomanticOrientationValue`](../classes/gmeow-RomanticOrientationValue.md) or mint a fresh labelled individual, and let the facet carry the disclosure facets; when the value is held only loosely, record [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md) [`gmeow:determinacyFuzzy`](../individuals/gmeow-determinacyFuzzy.md) on the facet rather than on this functional link.

### Examples

- ex:lillithRomOrient [`gmeow:romanticOrientationValue`](gmeow-romanticOrientationValue.md) [`gmeow:romanticBiromantic`](../individuals/gmeow-romanticBiromantic.md).
